description:
YouTube Access Pro คือโปรแกรมเสริมสำหรับ NVDA ที่ให้เข้าถึง YouTube ได้อย่างเต็มรูปแบบด้วยแป้นพิมพ์เพียงอย่างเดียว ค้นหาหรือวางลิงก์เพื่อเล่นและดาวน์โหลดวิดีโอ เพลย์ลิสต์ หรือช่องได้โดยตรง พร้อมคีย์ลัดควบคุมการเล่นครบครัน (เล่น/หยุด กรอ ปรับเสียง ปรับความเร็ว เล่นต่อเนื่องอัตโนมัติ) และตัวจับเวลาปิดในตัว

จัดการเพลย์ลิสต์ส่วนตัวได้อิสระ และติดตามช่องที่ชื่นชอบผ่านแท็บ Subscriptions ซึ่งไล่ดูเนื้อหาได้เหมือน YouTube เอง แบ่งเป็นหมวด Videos, Shorts, Live และ Playlists ดาวน์โหลดเป็นไฟล์ MP3 หรือ MP4 ได้ทันทีพร้อมเลือกคุณภาพ และจัดเก็บเป็นหมวดหมู่ตามเพลย์ลิสต์หรือช่องให้อัตโนมัติ

ใช้งานได้ทั้งภาษาไทยและอังกฤษ สลับได้ทันทีด้วย Ctrl+T เรียกหน้าต่างขึ้นมาจากทุกที่ด้วย NVDA+Y และฟังสรุปคีย์ลัดของแต่ละหน้าได้ทันทีด้วย Ctrl+F1 คู่มือฉบับเต็มพร้อมรายละเอียดคีย์ลัดทั้งหมดแนบมากับโปรแกรมเสริมนี้

YouTube Access Pro is an NVDA add-on that provides full keyboard-only access to YouTube. Search or paste a link to play and download videos, playlists, or channels directly, with complete playback shortcuts (play/pause, seek, volume, speed, automatic continuous playback) and a built-in sleep timer.

Manage personal playlists freely, and follow favorite channels through the Subscriptions tab, browsing content the way YouTube itself organizes it - Videos, Shorts, Live, and Playlists. Download instantly as MP3 or MP4 with selectable quality, automatically sorted into folders by playlist or channel.

Available in both Thai and English, switch instantly with Ctrl+T. Open the window from anywhere with NVDA+Y, and hear a shortcut summary for the current tab anytime with Ctrl+F1. A full user guide with complete shortcut details is included with this add-on.
changelog:
2026.09.02: Confirmed compatibility with NVDA 2026.2 (released 2026-08-31) and updated lastTestedNVDAVersion accordingly. Reviewed NVDA 2026.2's developer changelog (new Magnifier, touch gestures, speech dictionaries, braille auto-scroll, deprecated speechDictHandler constants) and confirmed none of it affects this add-on's code, since this add-on does not use any of those APIs - no functional code changes were needed.
2026.08.25: Fixed MP4 downloads failing outright while MP3 downloads kept working normally. The MP4 download format selector only matched a video that YouTube had already muxed together with its audio into one file - YouTube increasingly does not offer such a combined format at all for many videos anymore, so the download matched nothing and failed. MP4 downloads now request the best available video and audio streams separately and mux them together with the bundled ffmpeg (same as this add-on already does for live playback and MP3 extraction), which works regardless of whether YouTube offers a combined format for a given video.
2026.08.20: Fixed the automatic yt-dlp update checker only checking once every 24 hours, which made it easy to reasonably believe automatic updates were not working at all - it now checks on every NVDA startup instead (still only if enabled in Settings). Added a self-check that runs after a real restart to verify a yt-dlp update that reported success actually took effect, and warns you plainly if it did not (most likely causes: antivirus/Windows Defender blocking the newly-written files, or another NVDA installation on this computer) instead of silently staying on the old version with no explanation. Updated the bundled yt-dlp library to the latest stable release (2026.08.19).
2026.08.18: Updated the bundled yt-dlp library (2026.07.04 to a 2026.08.17 pre-release build) to fix YouTube extraction breaking for pasted links ("Could not fetch data") - YouTube had changed something extraction-dependent since the previous release, and yt-dlp's maintainers had already shipped several fix builds ahead of their next stable release. Currently-live broadcasts now open directly in the user's default browser instead of playing inside the add-on, since the browser's own native YouTube player handles live playback more reliably than the bundled offline media player ever could. Added a "Live" search type alongside Video/Playlist/Channel, to find currently-live broadcasts by keyword directly from the Search and Download tab (previously only reachable per-channel via the Subscriptions tab's Live section). Also fixes an unrelated ordinary-video playback bug where mpv's own internal link resolver was incorrectly re-engaging on links this add-on had already resolved itself, occasionally cutting playback short before the end.
2026.07.19: Full-featured release. Search, play, and download YouTube videos, playlists, and channels entirely by keyboard - audio playback with full transport control (play/pause, seek, volume, speed, previous/next with automatic continue), a sleep timer, personal playlist management, and a Subscriptions tab that browses a followed channel's Videos, Shorts, Live, and Playlists the way YouTube itself organizes them. Download to MP3 or MP4 with selectable quality, auto-sorted into folders by playlist or channel name. Full English/Thai interface with instant switching (Control+T).
